dataset_design.universe_rule: Fixed six-symbol MVP proposed by official CED Freeze Pack; eligible only while listed; not a historical liquidity-ranked population
dataset_design.selection_bias: RETROSPECTIVE_FIXED_UNIVERSE; restrict inference to these symbols
dataset_design.source_family: Official historical monthly 1m kline archives plus provider checksums
dataset_design.tier_b: EXCLUDED until separate manifest: funding, spot, OI, mark/index/basis
dataset_design.tier_c: EXCLUDED: book, liquidation, aggTrades, sub-minute, cross-venue, news/social/on-chain

integrity.duplicates: 0; conflicting or exact duplicates block clean admission, do not silently deduplicate
integrity.ohlc_rule: positive finite prices; low<=open,close<=high; nonnegative volumes/counts; buy volume<=total within decimal parsing tolerance
integrity.expected_rows: from verified listing intervals and official outages; do not invent pre-listing history
integrity.gap_rule: record every gap; exclude every dependent feature/label window; any unexpected contiguous gap >5 minutes blocks affected module until reviewed; no post-outcome waiver
integrity.normalization: deterministic decimal parsing, ordered symbol/open_time; immutable original bytes; versioned transform and config hash

holdout.selection_rule: No future holdout may be assigned, acquired, inspected or inferred automatically. Holdout selection requires a separate explicit protocol decision.

causality.support_rule: Entire feature+threshold-history+label support within own split. First 31 days are warm-up only, covering 30-day quantiles plus max 60-minute windows and lagged return. Entry and exit including 2-minute latency stress must precede split end.
causality.purge: discard crossing label/support intervals, no forward-fill; feature thresholds use completed observations strictly before event
causality.overlap: per configuration/symbol skip later signals until current position exits; simultaneous symbols remain clustered together
causality.future_holdout_embargo: UNASSIGNED; requires separate explicit protocol decision

costs.units: bps of gross notional, round-trip unless per_fill explicitly named
costs.bands_role: nonfunding trading-cost sensitivities, not actual fees or fills
costs.funding_rule: signed actual settlement debit added separately, once, at contractual exposure times; crossing settlement without verified funding module makes net-funded result NOT_TESTABLE

confirmation.model_status: NOT_VERIFIED_EXECUTION; numerical venue-specific contract required before 2025 outcomes
confirmation.formula: net=gross-fees-spread-slippage-latency-funding; no double counting when execution price already embeds a component
confirmation.actual_contract: max(floor, independently evidenced fee+spread+slippage+latency budget); each component and date-effective fee schedule frozen in child before OOS
confirmation.bar_open: reference-price sensitivity only; cannot substantiate executable CANDIDATE
confirmation.missed_fills: not assumed zero; fill/capacity gate NOT_TESTABLE without evidence

scout_score.missing: 0 points; missing critical evidence invokes hard veto
scout_score.ranking_sample: Discovery 2021-2024 only; no separately designated validation split

economic_magnitude.metric: mean net bps at BASE=10, before separately disclosed funding

temporal_repeatability.metric: fraction of active months with positive BASE net

parameter_stability.metric: fraction of adjacent grid neighbors with positive BASE net and >=50% selected mean; at least 2 neighbors

sample_sufficiency.metric: minimum ratio of event/day/week/month counts to Scout floors

cross_context_consistency.metric: for asset-specific F06 claim: fraction of 4 UTC six-hour bins with positive BASE net and >=50 events; bins without sufficient sample count as nonpositive, not dropped

mechanism.metric: pre-data written mechanism review, frozen before Scout; score equals fulfilled checklist count 0..5
checklist: economic causal rationale independent of outcomes
raw fields measure proposed mechanism directly

low_concentration.metric: max ratio of observed absolute-PnL shares to declared caps; undefined denominator -> missing; asset cap only for portfolio claims

scores_0_to_5: causal reference-price and latency sensitivity; no executable fills

cost_robustness.metric: highest nonfunding band with positive mean; funded claims require funding data

scout_score.context_cell_accounting: Four UTC bins used only in one fixed composite diagnostic, not independently selected hypotheses; no standalone significance claims. If selected/claimed independently, each bin becomes an atomic test and must enter budget and multiplicity before running.

sample_rules.unit: one non-overlapping configuration/symbol event or predeclared portfolio event
sample_rules.cluster: same UTC calendar week shared across symbols; not individual correlated trades
sample_rules.effective_sample_reporting: event count, active UTC days and active complete-week clusters separately; weekly cluster count is a conservative proxy, not proven independent N
sample_rules.underpowered_status: INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE, never NO EDGE solely for insufficiency
sample_rules.other_mechanism_families: no generic floor exemption; new pre-registered contract before eligibility

stability.asset_specific_claim: report per-symbol; do not fabricate multiasset consistency
stability.leave_one_month_out: all aggregate base-net means must remain >0 for confirmation

statistics.scout: raw p and BH q at 5% diagnostic for every declared family; q<0.05 not survival requirement
statistics.family_atomic_unit: one config x outcome/horizon x asset-or-predeclared-portfolio x context cell; opposite directions and variants count separately
statistics.family_size: all preregistered atomic cells; failed/insufficient cells retain null metrics and use p=1 only internally in adjustment denominator
statistics.primary_metric: mean net bps per non-overlapping event under frozen base execution contract
statistics.alternative: mean net bps >2 in frozen direction
statistics.confirmatory_correction: Holm FWER 0.05 across every finalist primary cell and confirmatory variant, family frozen before 2025 access
statistics.bootstrap: resample complete UTC weeks jointly across symbols, preserve within-week event rows; recompute sum(net)/count; one-sided centered-null bootstrap p with plus-one correction; percentile 95% CI
statistics.dependence_failure: if assumed weekly clustering is inadequate, flag unresolved model adequacy; no silent block-length retune on OOS
statistics.confirmation_pass_state: Use workflow tag CONFIRMED_SHORTLIST or HOLDOUT_ELIGIBLE; official result state remains CONTEXT-DEPENDENT until own Final Holdout passes; never promotion
statistics.bootstrap_null_detail: For each finalist, Tobs=event-weighted mean(net). Center each event at net-Tobs+2. Resample joint UTC-week blocks with replacement, recompute event-weighted T*. p=(1+count[T*>=Tobs])/(9999+1). Percentile CI uses uncentered joint-week bootstrap. All-zero-count resamples are invalid and counted; >1% invalid resamples blocks inference, no silent resampling until success.
statistics.validation_rule: No separate validation split. Discovery is 2021-2024; Confirmation is 2025. No Discovery outcome may be relabeled Confirmation.
statistics.confirmation_variants: At most 3 shortlisted cells per family plus union of their immediate predeclared grid neighbors; all unique cells enter fixed Holm family, even failed tests (internal p=1). No new grid values from 2024/2025 outcomes. Total union <=96 for proposed F06 grid.

campaign.cost_bands: vector of sensitivities in same row, not separate hypotheses; if used as separately selected outcome they consume atomic budget
campaign.neighbors: adjacent listed grid values only, never unlogged additional tests
campaign.expansion: new Run ID and preregistered budget; same hypothesis family cumulative history retained; no OOS rescue
campaign.mechanism_definition: Minute t denotes bar open timestamp. After bar t closes at t+1 minute, use previous w bars ending before t: range=max(high)/min(low)-1 <= q20 of analogous w-bar ranges in strictly earlier 30 days. Shock abs(log(close_t/close_t-1)) >= q90/q95 of strictly earlier 30-day absolute 1m returns. Quantiles use linear interpolation type 7; ties qualify; zero shock excluded. Continuation takes shock sign; reversal its opposite. Earliest base reference entry is open at t+2 minutes (1 full minute after close availability); stress open t+3. Exit open exactly horizon minutes after entry. No intrabar stops. Entire support, including quantile warm-up and exit, must be clean and within own split.
